I. Exposition Chapter on Terms (Pan. n. attivāra Uddesa)

1. Chapter on Purification of Words (Padasodhanavāra)

Positive (Anuloma)

It is eye. Is it eye element? 10. Divine eye and Wisdom eye are eye, but not eye element. Eye element is both eye and eye element. It is eye element. Is it eye? Yes.
